title: Full-network PRIMAT numerical-convergence study

scope.primary_question: Quantify numerical sensitivity of standard-BBN observables and abundance trajectories to ODE relative tolerance, nuclear-rate master-grid resolution, and background-temperature-grid resolution, independently and jointly.
included: nuclear reaction-rate master T9 grid refinement
excluded: nuclear rate central-value variation or covariance sampling
high-precision acceptance of the heavy nuclide tail

fixed_configuration.note: Absolute tolerances remain fixed during the numerical_precision sweep. This design therefore tests configured relative-tolerance sensitivity at these absolute-tolerance floors, not every possible atol refinement.
fixed_configuration.resolved_config_inheritance: Every resolved PRIMAT config field and physical constant in the R0 execution manifest is held fixed by exact type and value unless explicitly listed as a changed field in the corresponding run-matrix row.

network_control.acceptance_reference: Pinned PRIMAT NUCLIDE_REL_TOL=1e-4 is a network-comparison reference only; it is not a numerical-convergence criterion.

rules: Compute both weak and thermal fingerprints with pinned PRIMATConfig before any solver run.
sampling_temperature_per_decade changes the non-thermal weak-rate fingerprint; do not reuse BG2000 nTOp at BG4000 or BG8000.
The thermal CCRTh fingerprint intentionally excludes sampling_temperature_per_decade; verify unchanged hash and exact bytes, then reuse the S0 thermal cache.
rate_grid_npts and numerical_precision do not change weak-cache identity.
For BG4000 and BG8000, create only the expected new non-thermal weak table in a dedicated isolated overlay; record input fingerprint, generator environment, SHA-256 and Git blob SHA.
Once frozen, a cache artifact is immutable and shared by all same-grid runs.
Any unexpected cache file, hash change, thermal recompute, missing load event, fallback path or upstream source mutation is an engineering failure.
cache_policy.generator_closure: Reconstruct BG2000 without replacement; require abs(generated-shipped)<=1e-10*max(abs(generated),abs(shipped))+1e-26 at every entry. The absolute term covers only the negligible low-T clamp/noise region of rates in 1/tau_n units. Failure blocks production as a generator confound.

numerical_budget.rationale: One tenth of the corresponding pinned PRIMAT regression tolerances, chosen before observing R1-R8.
numerical_budget.relative_difference_definition: abs(x_run-x_R0)/max(abs(x_run),abs(x_R0),1e-300) for final species; trajectory metric uses the per-species trajectory norm defined in OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md.
numerical_budget.trajectory_metric: For each species, normalize pointwise absolute deviations by max(max_T(abs(Y_R0)), max_T(abs(Y_run)), 1e-30); report per-era maximum, temperature location and both absolute and normalized values. Trajectory metric is diagnostic unless separately thresholded in the preregistration.

upstream_reference_tolerances.source: PRIMAT tests/reference_values.py at the pinned commit

grid_axes.rule: Report signed increments, absolute increments, ratio and p_obs. Do not force p=2. Undefined order near roundoff is reported as plateau/undefined. Sign changes, growth under refinement or implausible order trigger REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rtol_axis.rule: Report R1-R0, R2-R1 and R2-R0. Do not apply the grid-order formula to rtol. Non-decreasing response or an apparent atol floor is unresolved.

joint_interaction.rule: Report interaction residuals for every observable. A small total joint shift cannot mask a failed one-axis gate.

operational_rules.grid_rule: Both increments below roundoff: PLATEAU_ORDER_UNRESOLVED. Otherwise require same sign, shrinking fine increment and 0<p<=4. Else REVIEW_REQUIRED.
operational_rules.rtol_rule: Both increments below roundoff: PLATEAU_ATOL_UNRESOLVED. Otherwise require shrinking fine increment. No order formula for rtol.
operational_rules.overall: Any hard budget breach: NUMERICAL_CONVERGENCE_FAIL. Budgets pass but any unresolved/review axis: INCONCLUSIVE, with separate NUMERICAL_STABILITY_PASS. Else NUMERICAL_CONVERGENCE_PASS limited to fixed-atol protocol. Neff invariant under ODE/rate-grid is STRUCTURALLY_UNCHANGED and not a standalone blocker.

convergence_analysis.historical_diagnostics: Report all Rk-R0 separately. Form primary axis increments, hard gates and joint interactions with R_ENV replacing R0.

acceptance_gates.baryon_handoff_step: report separately; do not renormalize or treat the expected Saha seed as integration drift
acceptance_gates.anchor_rule: In all inherited Rk_vs_R0 gate labels, R0 is replaced by R_ENV for primary comparisons; retain historical diagnostics separately.

trajectory_contract.output_per_run: three era raw arrays and dense traces with exact species order and units
trajectory_contract.common_coordinate: temperature T within each era, not equal cosmic time
trajectory_contract.do_not_claim: Dense samples are audit points, not all internal adaptive ODE steps.

components: HT initial and final B; HT integration drift
MT initial B; HT-to-MT Saha-seed increment relative to HT final B
MT final B; MT integration drift
LT initial B; MT-to-LT transfer/projection increment
LT raw final B; LT integration drift
post-solver clamp and zero-fill increment, reported separately
baryon_budget_contract.source_basis: Pinned primat/nuclear_network.py::_solve_MT explicitly adds Saha composite seeds on top of HT n+p without renormalization.

resource_and_run_controls.exact_resource_caps: Set only after an N1-specific target-runner probe and a published forecast; do not inherit S0 limits without recalibration.
resource_and_run_controls.initial_calibration: Cache builders then one coarse-precision full-network probe at maximum grids, not a convergence datum
resource_and_run_controls.production_forecast: Ten strict solves including R_ENV plus measured preparations/probe; target calibration and complete forecast must fit ceilings before R_ENV.

required_artifacts: one execution manifest and process receipt per newly executed run
raw HT/MT/LT solver arrays and dense traces per run

status_rules.numerical_convergence: only for this pinned solver, network, rate set, background and input point

review_gate: Owner instructed launch after explicit R_ENV proposal; execute within frozen matrix/budgets and measured target admission without another permission request.

authorization.scope: Includes proposed R_ENV control, ten strict integrations, technical fixes and publication. No scientific acceptance or main merge.

prelaunch_amendments.typed_config: 100.0 float inherited from exact R0 manifest; no physics change
prelaunch_amendments.solver_method: BDF family includes pinned _BDFDirectLU subclass; record actual class
prelaunch_amendments.electron_thermo: Allow electron_thermo_45b89f3e1b24e961.txt during initialization-only preparation of each group, then freeze; none generated in solver workers
prelaunch_amendments.generator_closure: Reconstruct BG2000 without replacement; require abs(generated-shipped)<=1e-10*max(abs(generated),abs(shipped))+1e-26 at every entry. The absolute term covers only the negligible low-T clamp/noise region of rates in 1/tau_n units. Failure blocks production as a generator confound.
prelaunch_amendments.trajectory_boundary: Use exact R0 T arrays. Clip only time boundary overshoots <=1e-9*max(t_end,1 s), record clipping. No R0 trace interpolation.
prelaunch_amendments.environment: R_ENV measures displacement from historical R0 and anchors primary convergence on the actual current BLAS architecture. Every new worker must match the frozen target environment; pinned package versions and one-thread limits remain required.
prelaunch_amendments.absolute_tolerance: HT atol remains 1e-10; rtol sensitivity at fixed atol cannot establish complete ODE accuracy.

environment_control.rule: Exact R0 configuration on current executor; primary convergence and network comparisons use R_ENV. R_ENV minus R0 is separately reported; R0 untouched.
